description: Confirmatory experiment protocol for the ExtStats Advisor paper. This file freezes required evidence and comparison semantics; new work uses the scoped system-freeze-v2 while historical artifact provenance remains per manifest.

postgresql_identity_source.rule: Use the built role identity as the source of exact PostgreSQL source/version/configuration/build provenance; do not infer final paper pins from a floating version string.

system_under_test.scope: advisor, patched PostgreSQL, stock PostgreSQL, their build contracts, and the scoped v2 Advisor execution/budget contract

historical_artifact_freeze_policy.rule: Existing RQ1 and Forest10 RQ4 artifacts retain their embedded system-freeze-v1 provenance and are not retroactively reassigned to v2.

freeze_gate.rule: Use system-freeze-v2 for new confirmatory work and record the actual committed research harness SHA in every experiment artifact; do not substitute a floating PostgreSQL version or a global research SHA. Historical artifacts remain bound to the freeze recorded in their own manifests.

seed_policy.semantic_rule: The seed identifier and the PostgreSQL floating-point setseed argument are distinct protocol fields. Integer-division spelling is forbidden.

datasets.production_exact_role: independent Census13 equivalence validation and production truth-acquisition cost path
independent validation/cost path only; no repeated benchmark truth recollection
independent validation/cost path only; no repeated benchmark truth recollection
independent validation/cost path only; no repeated benchmark truth recollection

ground_truth_input.role: Evaluate planner estimates and define utility; never construct native statistics and never alter the PostgreSQL estimator.

source_kinds.collection: Exact counts in a read-only repeatable-read source view.
source_kinds.constraints: Only the supported sealed postgresql-simple-selection-v2 workload contract; exact collection can be expensive.

source_kinds.collection: Import and validate externally produced exact labels with provenance and snapshot/workload binding.
source_kinds.constraints: The advisor must not claim to have executed externally supplied labels.

confirmatory_arecel_policy.rule: Every fresh AdvisorSnapshot imports the observations into a new GroundTruthSet; a GroundTruthSet from another snapshot is never reused.
confirmatory_arecel_policy.production_exact_role: Independent validation mechanism and measured production exact-count cost path, not the default repeated benchmark truth acquisition.

metrics_and_objectives.optimization_objective: sum(weight_q * Q_q) / sum(weight_q) over positive-weight workload queries
metrics_and_objectives.uniform_weight_rule: If a confirmatory workload has weight one for every query, arithmetic mean and the optimization objective coincide numerically but remain distinct contracts.

required_baseline_configurations.role: RQ1 stock baseline and deployment target
required_baseline_configurations.postgresql_build_identity: paper/system-freeze-v2.json:stock_postgresql.required_build_contract plus the per-run postgres-lab identity digest

required_baseline_configurations.dataset_variation_rule: Preserve any audited dataset-specific baseline difference and record it in the manifest. Current four paper-baseline manifests record target 10000; Census13 records the target at baseline level.

fixed_k_quality.k_policy: Pre-register k independently of the final advisor recommendation.
fixed_k_quality.ground_truth_policy: Heuristic selection cannot use GroundTruthSet; utility-based methods use the same bound GroundTruthSet after selection as declared by RQ4.
fixed_k_quality.budget_policy: Declare and report a maximum configuration-objective-evaluation budget; report PostgreSQL per-query planner calls, preprocessing, final evaluation, and elapsed time separately.

fixed_evaluation_budget.budget_policy: Pre-register common configuration-objective-evaluation and wall-clock caps; independent stock full-data evaluation is outside the selection budget.
fixed_evaluation_budget.information_policy: Do not convert unused budget into extra information for another method; distinguish at-most-k local optimum, budget-censored, and genuinely infeasible outcomes.

experiments.configuration_scope_note: The matched RQ1 artifact is the fixed three-arm comparison (stock default, stock target10000, and advisor). workload-frequency-top-k, native-payload-size-top-k, singleton-utility-top-k, random-k, greedy ADD, and exhaustive tiny-universe comparisons belong to RQ4 and are not complete merely because the RQ1 dataset campaign advances.

canary_protocol.historical_artifact_role: The existing Census13 canary is retained as the immutable planner-execution source; its production-exact GroundTruthSet is one-time equivalence evidence, while the canonical derived result imports audited AreCEL observations.
canary_protocol.budget_selection_basis: Pre-existing experiments/arecel-census13/search-budget-k8/calibration-v1.json: 60 and 120 seconds expired incomplete rounds; 180 seconds was the first local-optimum completion. This value is frozen before the canary and is not outcome-tuned.
canary_protocol.headline_evaluation: stock PostgreSQL full-data deployment; never the patched sandbox objective

forest10_confirmatory_protocol.headline_evaluation: stock PostgreSQL full-data deployment; sandbox objective is separate

power7_confirmatory_protocol.headline_evaluation: stock PostgreSQL full-data deployment; sandbox objective is separate
power7_confirmatory_protocol.in_workload_scope: The RQ1 workload is the workload used by the advisor objective; this result does not establish held-out query generalization.

cross_dataset_summary.revision_reason: Strictly separate observations, snapshot-bound GroundTruthSet, historical production-exact truth, and Census13 equivalence-bound external truth provenance. Estimates and metrics are unchanged.

formal_v2.eligible_universe_freeze: utility-independent supported kind/schema/sample-payload/predeclared-compatibility allowlist; frozen before GroundTruthSet, singleton utility, or SearchResult access
formal_v2.source_reuse: RQ2 v2 snapshot, authoritative GroundTruthSet, candidate universe, native repository, and singleton profile only after identity/digest/coverage validation
formal_v2.greedy_semantics: exact incidence-incremental full-map utility; strict improvement; at-most-k local optimum; no forced fill; worst-case live proposals 3N-6
formal_v2.truth_source: authoritative-external-exact; no silent production-exact fallback; no new 10000-query COUNT

primary_eligible_universe.conditional_screened_universe: A utility/outcome-screened universe, if used, is a separately labeled conditional diagnostic and cannot replace the primary universe.

experiments.ground_truth_policy: Only utility-based methods use GroundTruthSet during selection; every selected result is evaluated against the same bound truth.
experiments.random_seed_policy: Formal random-k replicates use pre-registered seeds [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]; report each plus mean/std/min/max. Break non-random ties by candidate ID after declared score/static precedence.
experiments.deployment_policy: Every method uses the same canonical evaluation/deployment ordering and records membership, evaluation order, deployment order, and physical identities.
experiments.independent_evaluation: RQ4b stock PostgreSQL physical estimates with the same authoritative truth; sandbox objective, configuration evaluations, per-query planner calls, preprocessing, native realization, and final evaluation costs are separate.

deterministic_replay_contract.formal_raw_storage: The Forest10 replay is lossless gzip-compressed JSON because the uncompressed raw evidence exceeds GitHub's single-file limit; artifact_sha256 and semantic_digest are both recorded.

shared_physical_realization_contract.clone_policy: clone one analyzed parent, drop unrelated statistics without ANALYZE, verify remaining payload bytes

entries.note: The four-dataset, three-arm, in-workload matched comparison is complete with the immutable cross-dataset summary. This does not complete RQ4 heuristic ablations or establish held-out query generalization.
Existing baseline artifacts are preliminary and require confirmatory provenance audit.

Four independent frozen-v2 children passed validation. The derived cross-dataset summary is experiments/rq2-cross-dataset-transfer-summary-v1.json (digest dbf6fe6f734039e6de7040406d24aa05baec4b81d1fec1ecc5280b8998a5dfc7); historical full-data-transfer-k8 artifacts remain pilot/preliminary.
The four validated children record paired sample/full utility, 3x3 direction agreement, and descriptive Spearman transfer diagnostics under one truth contract; no inferential p-value is claimed.
Calibration artifacts are supporting diagnostics, not completed ablations.
Three-query Census13 smoke passed through the frozen patched planner/utility backend and a separate one-MCV frozen stock deployment-contract probe; this is integration readiness evidence only.

The v2 live hardening fixture passed B=3,2,1, exact bounded-reference/incremental traces, empty-incidence ADD, nonincident audit, local-optimum/max-count/deadline termination, and explicit v1 reference coverage. This is implementation-readiness evidence only, not a formal AreCEL ablation.

The historical dependency/correlation baseline-definition audit remains preserved as blocked, while experiments/rq4-dependency-baseline-definition-resolution-v1.json resolves the semantic name as native-payload-size-top-k. Census13, Power7, and DMV11 passed the frozen v2 RQ4a replay and RQ4b shared-stock gates; Forest10 remains immutable historical v1 evidence and was not rerun. The global RQ4 program remains incomplete because fixed-evaluation-budget and native-ANALYZE stability are separate protocols.
The 2,000 configuration-evaluation/300-second contract is frozen, but the common budget-comparison allocator is not implemented; the harness fails closed rather than reusing fixed-k logic.

Power7 is complete as a validated formal child at experiments/arecel-power7/rq4-ks-sensitivity-v1/rq4-ks-sensitivity-v1.json (digest 85b832eae7f253d7306b710ed769b5a9d48914bc4ad773c00e45c6a93a9db8e5); Census13 and DMV11 were not executed, so global K_s sensitivity and global RQ4 remain incomplete. The protocol's formal_arecel_runs gate remains false until the full campaign is complete.
Five independent native ANALYZE realizations are pre-registered to quantify stock realization variability; no stability run has been executed.

Formal artifact experiments/rq3/rq3-primary-mechanism-fidelity-v1.json (digest e3304129...) completed on the frozen patched build: 3 configurations, 9 exact Plan Rows pairs, zero mismatches, payload/fingerprint controls, and cleanup verified.

Formal artifact experiments/rq3/rq3-secondary-build-sanity-v1.json (digest 2678bb4e...) completed: stock and patched physical paths matched for three configurations and 9 pairs with overlay inactive and cleanup verified.
